newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen higher to test 8,600 points.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen higher to test 8,600 points.

text.p: Taiwan share prices are expected to continue rising on Tuesday to test a six-year resistance at 8,600 points, but brokers also noted profit-taking pressure after four straight days of gains.
On Monday, the benchmark index ended up 150.13 points or 1.79 percent at 8,517.70. A 8,450-8,600 range was seen for Tuesday.
"Despite the index gaining so much, the bullish sentiment seems unstoppable. It should be able to test 8,600 points today," said National Securities manager Allen Huang.
In recent sessions, Huang noted, institutional investors had shown mixed investment attitudes, with local mutual funds showing net selling while foreign funds representing net buying.
Low-priced and shares and those showing improving fundamentals such as semiconductors and steel should continue to attract buying, he said.
"But many analysts have mixed views on whether semiconductor shares can recover so strongly as some had predicted," Huang said.
